Maps a full FormID to its compact save-game IRef index: returns an existing array index or appends the FormID and returns the new index. Created IDs (0xFFxxxxxx) pass through unchanged. This is FormID->IRef, despite the former reversed name.
MEF v56 implementation: coherent first-index auxiliary table for numeric IDs. Created>=FF000000h pass through; zero/duplicates preserve lowest index. Small arrays scan directly; larger tables use bounded private process-heap hash storage. Checked append publishes only stable array state. Auxiliary/refusal paths call native trampoline; no invented zero index. No private cache lock spans engine allocation/free.
